better_weaponry.doc.readme.errors: If a value is invalid (wrong type, out of range), it is ignored and the previous value is kept. Errors are shown in the chat to operators and to the host of a single-player game, and written to logs/latest.log. Comments starting with // are allowed, and so are keys starting with _ (for example "_note").
better_weaponry.doc.readme.folders:
What is in this folder:
  weapons/          one file per weapon type: add the fields you want to change.
  rules.json        global rules (dual wielding...).
  defaults/         the mod's default values, rewritten at every launch. Read them and copy fields from them, but do not edit them.
  *.schema.json     used by code editors such as VS Code: autocompletion, help when hovering a field, errors underlined.
  README.txt        this file, rewritten at every launch in the game's language.
better_weaponry.doc.readme.intro: This folder changes the stats of the Better Weaponry weapons for all your worlds. Your files only contain what you change: everything else keeps the mod's default values, even after an update.
better_weaponry.doc.readme.title: Better Weaponry: weapon settings
better_weaponry.doc.readme.weapon_fields: Fields of a weapon file (all optional):
better_weaponry.editor.client.note: Your own display preferences, saved on this computer.

better_weaponry.editor.preset.near_vanil: Weapons keep their stats, reach and sweep. No armor penetration, on-hit effects, two-handed, dual wield, parry, dash or combos. Mobs go back to their default settings.
better_weaponry.editor.preset.pvp_1_8.to: Only the simple 1.8 parry: no perfect parry, guard break, weapon reach, sweep or other system. The attack cooldown itself stays that of current Minecraft. Mobs go back to their default settings.
better_weaponry.editor.reset.tooltip: Put every value of this file back to the mod's default values (kept only if you click Save).

better_weaponry.editor.title: Better Weaponry: weapon editor

better_weaponry.editor.tooltips.preset.a: Every line is shown, no key needed.
better_weaponry.editor.tooltips.preset.d: Main stats visible, the rest behind the key.
better_weaponry.editor.tooltips.preset.m: Only reach, damage and attack speed.

better_weaponry.field.gear.enchanted_boo: Chance in % for a chest of the Nether or the End to hold a book with one of the mod's enchantments.
better_weaponry.field.gear.format_versio: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
better_weaponry.field.gear.golden_draw_t: Draw or load time of golden bows and crossbows compared to vanilla. 0.5: twice as fast.
better_weaponry.field.gear.loot_upgrade_: In loot, starting from wood, chance in % of moving up to the next material (gold, stone, iron, diamond, netherite). Rolled again at each step.
better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.captain_: true: patrol and raid captains carry a shield of the mod in their off hand. It is never dropped.
better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.dual_wie: Among mobs that get a weapon of the mod, chance in % of having one in each hand. The off-hand weapon is never dropped.
better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.guard_ch: Each second near its target, chance in % that a mob with a shield or a parrying weapon raises its guard. An axe breaks it.
better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.help: Weapons and behavior of mobs. No more mobs are armed than in vanilla: only a mob that would get a vanilla weapon or tool can get a weapon of the mod instead.
better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.modded_w: Chance in % that a vanilla weapon or tool held by a hostile mob becomes a weapon of the mod. 0: mobs keep their vanilla weapons.
better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.ninja_sk: Chance in % that a skeleton throws shurikens instead of shooting a bow.
better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.upgrade_: Chance in % of moving up to the next material, rolled again at each step and 1.5 times higher on Hard. Limited to iron in the Overworld, diamond in the Nether and the End, one step more on Hard (not in the End).
better_weaponry.field.gear.projectile_sp: Highest speed multiplier, whatever the material. Arrow damage depends on speed: this keeps very strong modded materials under control.

Multiplier of the projectile speed of bows and crossbows, by material id, e.g. {"iron": 1.2}. Arrow damage depends on this speed: 1 is the vanilla bow, the stone one. Materials not listed use their damage multiplier minus 0.34.
better_weaponry.field.gear.reflect_arrow: true: an arrow stopped by a perfect parry with a shield flies back to its shooter.
better_weaponry.field.gear.reflective_co: After Reflective sends damage back, how long the weapon or shield is on cooldown, in seconds. 0: none.
better_weaponry.field.gear.replace_vanil: Replace vanilla gear in loot and trades
true: loot and villagers give the mod's versions instead of the vanilla item.
better_weaponry.field.gear.shield_perfec: How long this bonus stays available if you do not hit, in seconds.
After the window, how long before raising the shield can open a new one, in seconds.
Damage bonus after a shield perfect parry
Extra damage on your next melee hit after a perfect parry with a shield, in %. 0: no bonus.
How far a perfect parry with a shield pushes back a melee attacker. 0: no push.
Once the shield is up, how long a hit counts as a perfect parry, in seconds. 0: never.
better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.bas: Multiplied by the speed on impact, then rounded up. An arrow has 2.
better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.coo: Time before you can throw this shuriken again, in seconds.
better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.hel: Settings of the shurikens. Each throw uses 1 durability, picking the shuriken up gives it back. The material changes the speed, like for bows.
better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.thr: Speed of a stone shuriken. A fully drawn arrow flies at 3. Damage depends on speed.
better_weaponry.field.rules.armor_penetr: false: no weapon ignores armor, whatever its file says.
better_weaponry.field.rules.balance_abil: true: weapons with abilities (parry, dash, area combo, on-hit effects, shield disabling, armor penetration) deal slightly less damage, 12% less at most. false: damage only follows raw damage per second.
better_weaponry.field.rules.combat_chang: false: back to vanilla combat. Turns off every system below at once (reach, sweep, armor penetration, on-hit effects, two-handed, dual wield, parry, dash, combos). The weapons stay in the game with their own damage and attack speed.
better_weaponry.field.rules.combos_enabl: false: no weapon has a combo, whatever its file says.
better_weaponry.field.rules.dash_enabled: false: no weapon can dash, whatever its file says (the right click keeps its normal action).
better_weaponry.field.rules.dual_wield_e: false: holding a weapon in each hand gives nothing: only the main hand attacks.
better_weaponry.field.rules.dual_wield_i: How long a target ignores new hits after a hit made while holding a weapon in each hand, in seconds (vanilla: 0.5). Lower values let fast weapons such as daggers land every hit.
better_weaponry.field.rules.dual_wield_s: Attack speed multiplier while holding a weapon in each hand (1.5 = 50% faster).
better_weaponry.field.rules.format_versi: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
better_weaponry.field.rules.guard_break_: false: axes and weapons that disable shields no longer interrupt a parry.
better_weaponry.field.rules.on_hit_effec: false: weapons never give effects to their target (on_hit_effects is ignored).
better_weaponry.field.rules.parry_enable: false: no weapon can parry, whatever its file says (the right click keeps its normal action). Also turns off perfect parries and guard breaks.
better_weaponry.field.rules.perfect_parr: false: a hit taken at the very start of a parry is only reduced like any other.
better_weaponry.field.rules.pvp_max_hit_: Most damage a single melee hit can deal to another player, after armor, in % of their maximum health. 100: no limit.
better_weaponry.field.rules.reach_enable: false: every weapon has the normal reach of a player (attack_reach is ignored).
better_weaponry.field.rules.shield_disab: false: the mod's weapons no longer disable raised shields (disables_shield is ignored).
better_weaponry.field.rules.sweep_enable: false: weapons sweep exactly like a vanilla sword (the sweep object is ignored).
better_weaponry.field.rules.two_handed_e: false: no weapon locks the off hand (two_handed is ignored).
better_weaponry.field.weapon.ability.hel: What a right click does with this weapon in the main hand: "parry" (hold to block part of the damage, like swords in Minecraft 1.8), "dash" (a quick leap) or "none" (the right click keeps its normal action).
better_weaponry.field.weapon.armor_penet: Percentage of the target's armor ignored by this weapon's hits (0 = armor works normally, 100 = armor is ignored). Melee hits only. Shown on the tooltip when above 0.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.attack_reac: How far away you can hit entities, in blocks (vanilla: 3).
better_weaponry.field.weapon.attack_spee: Attacks per second at full strength (vanilla sword: 1.6). Above 2, part of the hits on a single target are lost to its invulnerability time.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.base_damage: Damage of the wooden version, as shown on the tooltip. Each material multiplies it by its own factor (stone ×1.25, iron ×1.5, diamond ×1.75, netherite ×2, gold ×1) and rounds it to the nearest half point.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.enabl: true: this weapon has a combo.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.help: A series of hits that repeats, with special hits. Each hit that lands moves the combo forward; a swing that hits nothing does not count. Special hits are always made with the main-hand weapon. On a dual-wielded weapon, the combo only exists with the same weapon type in the other hand.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.min_c: A hit charged below this percentage (attack indicator under the crosshair) resets the combo, so spamming clicks does not work. 0 = every hit counts.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.reset: The combo starts over after this many seconds without landing a hit. Switching weapons also resets it.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.steps: Width of the area in front of you, in degrees (90 = narrow cone, 180 = half circle, 360 = all around). Only used with a radius.
true: if the off hand holds the same weapon type, this hit strikes with both weapons at once: both arms swing, damage = average of the two weapons, effects and wear of both weapons.
Cooldown of the next hit × this value (1.6 = 60% longer): a strong finisher takes time to recover from.
Damage of this hit × this value (1 = normal, 1.5 = 50% more).
The hits of the combo, in order; after the last one, it starts over. {} = normal hit. Example: [ {}, {}, { "radius": 3.5, "angle": 360 } ] = the 3rd hit strikes all around.
Extra knockback of this hit, in levels of the Knockback enchantment (1 = like Knockback I).
0 = normal hit on the target. Above 0, the hit also strikes every enemy within this distance, in blocks, and replaces the sweep attack.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.allow_: true: the dash also works while jumping or falling. false: you must be on the ground.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.cooldo: Time before the next dash, in seconds. Shared by every material of this weapon type.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.direct: "look": where you are looking (lunge). "input": where you are moving with the movement keys, for example sideways to dodge; forward if no key is held.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.distan: Approximate length of the dash on flat ground, in blocks. Farther on ice or in mid-air.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.help: Settings of the dash, used when ability is "dash". A right click throws you forward, then the weapon type has a cooldown (shown on the hotbar, shared by every material). Only works with the off hand empty or holding a weapon, never while riding, gliding with an elytra or in water or lava.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.hunger: Food used by each dash, in food points (1 = half a drumstick; a sprint jump uses about 0.05). Above 0, the dash is impossible when the hunger bar is at 3 drumsticks or less, like sprinting.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.disables_sh: true: like an axe, a hit on a raised shield disables it for 5 seconds.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.dual_wielde: true: this weapon can be used with another dual-wielded weapon in the other hand (hits alternate between the hands, and attacks are faster). Both weapons need this option. Ignored if the weapon is two-handed.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.format_vers: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.items.help: Other items that behave like this weapon, separated by commas: item ids, or tags starting with #. They get its parry or dash, combo, effects, sweep, armor penetration, two-handed and dual wield settings, but keep their own damage, speed and reach. The mod's own weapons are never changed.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.material_da: Forces the damage of some materials, for example { "golden": 6 }. Materials that are not listed use base_damage × their factor.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.on_hit_effe: Chance to give the effect on each hit, in % (100 = always).
Duration of the effect, in seconds.
Id of the effect, for example minecraft:slowness, minecraft:weakness or minecraft:poison.
Effects given to the target that is hit, for example slowness. List of objects: [ { "effect": "minecraft:slowness", "duration_seconds": 2 } ].
Level of the effect (1 = Slowness I, 2 = Slowness II...).
better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.damag: Part of the damage blocked, in % (100 = no damage). Hits from behind, falls, fire, poison and other damage that a shield cannot block are not reduced.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.durab: Durability lost per point of damage of the parried hit, rounded down (0.5 = half the damage of the hit; 0 = parrying never wears the weapon out). With a weapon in each hand, the wear is shared between both. A perfect parry costs nothing.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.guard: How long this weapon cannot parry after being hit by an axe or a weapon that disables shields, in seconds. A perfect parry is never broken. 0: this weapon's guard never breaks.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.help: Settings of the parry, used when ability is "parry". While right click is held, you move slowly and the hits you take from the front are reduced. Only works with the off hand empty, with a two-handed weapon, or, for a dual-wielded weapon, with another dual-wielded weapon in the off hand. A shield in the off hand is raised instead.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.perfe: How long the bonus stays available if you do not hit, in seconds.
After the window, how long before raising the guard can open a new one, in seconds. Prevents spamming the right click.
Damage bonus after a perfect parry
After a perfect parry, extra damage on your next melee hit, in %. 0: no bonus.
At the very start of a parry, how long a hit is blocked entirely, without wearing the weapon, in seconds. 0: never.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.damag: Damage of the sweep attack, in % of the weapon's damage (0 = 1 damage, like a vanilla sword without Sweeping Edge). Adds up with Sweeping Edge.
better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.enabl: false: this weapon never makes a sweep attack (thrusting weapons).
better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.help: The sweep attack that also hits the enemies around the target (fully charged hit, on the ground, without sprinting).
better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.radiu: Size of the zone around the target, in blocks (vanilla sword: 1). Still limited by the attack reach.
true: while the weapon is in the main hand, the off hand is hidden and cannot be used, and the weapon cannot be dual wielded.
better_weaponry.info.combo: Combo: consecutive hits follow a sequence of special attacks, shown on screen.
better_weaponry.info.dash: Dash: right click to dash forward. All materials of this weapon share the cooldown.
better_weaponry.info.disables_shield: Disables shields: a hit on a raised shield disables it for a few seconds, like an axe.
better_weaponry.info.dual_wielded: Dual wield: hold one of these weapons in each hand. Hits alternate between hands and come faster.
better_weaponry.info.parry: Parry: hold right click to reduce hits from the front. A hit at the very start of the parry is blocked entirely. Axes break your guard.
better_weaponry.info.ranged: Only the projectile speed depends on the material: arrow damage follows it. Gold loads twice as fast but shoots slower.
better_weaponry.info.shield: Raise it just before a hit for a perfect parry: arrows go back to the shooter and melee attackers are pushed away.
better_weaponry.info.shield.simple: Blocks hits from the front, like the vanilla shield. Its durability depends on its material.
better_weaponry.info.shuriken: Right click to throw. Each throw costs 1 durability; picking the shuriken back up returns it. Throwing the last point destroys the item, and picking that shuriken up brings it back.
better_weaponry.info.two_handed: Two-handed: your off hand must stay empty to use this weapon.
better_weaponry.tutorial.armor_penetrati: Without penetration, the armor only lets %s damage through.
Compare this value between weapons on the Comparison page.
This hammer deals %s damage. This zombie wears a full set of iron armor.
With %s %% penetration, the armor absorbs less: %s damage gets through.
better_weaponry.tutorial.attack_zone.are: The special hits of combos strike an area around you: here %s blocks over %s°. Only enemies inside are hit.
better_weaponry.tutorial.attack_zone.int: A sweeping hit also strikes the enemies around your target.
better_weaponry.tutorial.attack_zone.rad: The size of this area depends on the weapon: %s blocks for the scythe.
better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.finisher: The last hit strikes a whole area: %s blocks over %s°.
better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.hits: Each hit that lands advances the combo, shown on screen.
better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.intro: Some weapons chain a series of hits when you strike in rhythm.
better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.reset: If you do not hit for %s s, the combo starts over.
better_weaponry.tutorial.combos.title: Combos
better_weaponry.tutorial.dash.cooldown: The dash recharges in %s s, shared by all materials of this weapon.
better_weaponry.tutorial.dash.direction: Depending on the weapon, the dash follows your view or your movement keys.
better_weaponry.tutorial.dash.intro: Right click with a dash weapon to launch yourself forward.
better_weaponry.tutorial.dash.title: Dash
better_weaponry.tutorial.dual_wield.alte: Your hits alternate between the two hands.
better_weaponry.tutorial.dual_wield.intr: Dual-wielded weapons can be held one in each hand.
better_weaponry.tutorial.dual_wield.only: Only weapons marked "Dual wielded" can be used this way.
better_weaponry.tutorial.dual_wield.spee: They come %s times faster, and each hand uses the stats of its own weapon.
better_weaponry.tutorial.guard_break.bro: The hit is still reduced, but your guard drops and you cannot parry for %s s.
better_weaponry.tutorial.guard_break.int: Axes and some heavy weapons can break your guard.
better_weaponry.tutorial.guard_break.per: A perfect parry is never broken.
better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.behind: A hit in the back is not parried.
better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.front: Hits from the front are reduced by %s %%.
better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.intro: Hold right click with a parrying weapon to raise your guard.
better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.title: Parrying
better_weaponry.tutorial.parry.wear: Each parried hit wears the weapon a little.
better_weaponry.tutorial.perfect_parry.b: After a perfect parry, your next hit deals %1$s %% more damage. The bonus disappears after %2$s s.
better_weaponry.tutorial.perfect_parry.i: A hit taken at the very start of a parry is blocked entirely and does not wear the weapon.
better_weaponry.tutorial.perfect_parry.l: If the hit comes after the window, it is a normal parry. Raising your guard again and again does not reopen it right away.
better_weaponry.tutorial.perfect_parry.t: The window lasts %s s. Here the hit lands inside it: perfect parry!
better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.intro: Reach is how far you can hit. The circle shows it.
better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.long: The spear reaches %s blocks: the same enemy is hit.
better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.mobs: Mobs also respect the reach of their weapon.
better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.short: This dagger reaches %s blocks: the enemy is too far.
better_weaponry.tutorial.reach.title: Attack reach
better_weaponry.tutorial.two_handed.lock: While one is in your main hand, your off hand is locked: what it holds is hidden and cannot be used.
better_weaponry.tutorial.two_handed.one_: A one-handed weapon leaves the other hand free, for a shield for example.
enchantment.better_weaponry.bleeding.des: Fully charged hits make the target bleed for 2/3/4 seconds. Sickles, scythes and katanas only. Skeletons are immune. Incompatible with Fire Aspect and Vampirism.
enchantment.better_weaponry.execution.de: Deals 10/20/30% more damage to targets below 30% of their health.
enchantment.better_weaponry.reflective.d: A perfect parry sends 10/20/30% of a melee attack back at the attacker, along with its effects, then the item goes on cooldown. Goes on shields and on anything that can parry. Incompatible with Riposte.
enchantment.better_weaponry.returning.de: Shurikens that land fly back to you like a Loyalty trident and give their durability back. Incompatible with Mending.
enchantment.better_weaponry.riposte.desc: After a perfect parry, your next hit deals 25/50/75% more damage, on top of the usual bonus. Incompatible with Reflective.
enchantment.better_weaponry.vampirism.de: Heals you for part of the melee damage you deal. The healing grows more and more slowly on big hits. Incompatible with Bleeding.
